title: Te Hara i te Takutai
intro: E tū ana koe i runga i te onepū o te takutai kua warewaretia, kei reira ngā ngaru e kōrero ana mō tētahi hapori kua whakamatautauria e te whakahau a te Atua. E taumaha ana te hau i te mahara ki tētahi takahi i arahi ki tētahi panonitanga ohorere. Ko wai ēnei wairua, ā, he aha te āhua o tā rātou whakamātautau?
clues: He hapori mātou i whiwhi i tētahi ture mārama mai i tō mātou Ariki, heoi i kitea e mātou he huarahi hei whakahē i taua ture.
I noho mātou i te taha o tētahi wai, ā, i whakawhirinaki tō mātou oranga ki ngā mea ora o reira.
I tae mai te whakamātautau ki a tātou i te rā i whakahaua ai tātou kia kaua e whai i ngā mea o te ao.
I taua rā anō ka tae mai ngā mea hanga o te wai ki a mātou, he tini ke atu, ā, ka whakamatautauria mātou, nui atu i tō mātou kaha ki te manawanui.
I titoa e mātou tētahi mahi tinihanga hei karo i te ture a te Atua, i te whakaaro ka taea e mātou te tinihanga i te ture.
Nā tō mātou hara i huri ai mātou hei tangata whakama; i meinga mātou hei makimaki whakarihariha i runga i te whakahau a Allah.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
